items.title: Tiny native coding agent ships
items.oneliner: A 6.39 MiB coding agent runs locally or in cloud, with fast cold starts and Unix-style plugin extensibility.

items.title: Better GGUF quantization lands
items.oneliner: Quantization docs and downloads show Dynamic 3.0 improves top-1 percent accuracy by over 10 percent at same size.

items.title: On-device piano autocomplete works
items.oneliner: A 125M transformer autocompletes MIDI piano in real time on iPhone at about 108 notes per second.

items.title: Filtered vector search gets faster
items.oneliner: Qdrant explains ACORN variants that recover HNSW recall under metadata filters and improve filtered vector search throughput.

items.title: Linux geofencing for Find My
items.oneliner: Reverse-engineered tooling reads Find My People locations on Linux and triggers Discord geofence alerts automatically.

items.title: A 2 KB syntax highlighter
items.oneliner: This client-side syntax highlighter uses CSS Custom Highlights, ships around 2 KB gzipped, and avoids DOM wrapper spam.

items.title: Self-host social coding on atproto
items.oneliner: This walkthrough shows how to self-host a GitHub-like atproto forge with Docker Compose, Caddy, and federation.

items.title: Generate unusual color palettes fast
items.oneliner: A lightweight TypeScript function generates distinctive color palettes with no dependencies and can drop into web apps immediately.

items.title: Strip browser bloat systematically
items.oneliner: This hands-on guide shows policy files and settings to disable browser telemetry, AI features, and bundled clutter.

items.title: IBM XT gets a real browser
items.oneliner: A retro computing project now browses real web pages, runs CP/M 2.2, and even opens Word 1.1a.
